evals.prompt: Read the bounded current snapshot for this X account.
evals.expected_output: Use the live account read method by default and return bounded provider evidence through the account's bound credential.

evals.prompt: Prepare an exact X cleanup plan from supplied post evidence.
evals.expected_output: Return a digest-bound typed deletion plan without executing it.

evals.prompt: Audit the posts in this local X archive and return bounded account evidence.
evals.expected_output: Normalize and digest the admitted archive once, then return a truthful read-only audit result.

evals.prompt: Read my three most recent posts on X.
evals.expected_output: Read the authenticated account, page its posts until at least the requested count, and return every post of those whole pages with where the next read starts.

evals.prompt: Show the recent X work in this workspace.
evals.expected_output: Return an empty bounded page, without X calls or guessed account work.

evals.prompt: Select the reviewed non-mutual X accounts from supplied archives.
evals.expected_output: Return the exact deterministic unfollow plan without changing the account.

evals.prompt: Select matching reposts from my X archive.
evals.expected_output: Return the deterministic matching act plan and its native digest.

evals.prompt: Inspect progress for this saved X plan.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this store has no saved plan and provide the exact recovery step without an X call.

evals.prompt: Continue the reviewed cleanup after the provider refused the account credential.
evals.expected_output: It stops for review: the given outcome shows the provider refused the credential before any delete was sent, so no act is processed or retried and no next batch is proposed, with nothing sent.
expectations: It does not retry after the account refusal.
It does not count the unsent delete as failed terminal work.

evals.prompt: Continue this approved update and account work from where it stopped.
evals.expected_output: It continues from the given progress, the thread second part next and then the follow and the unfollow, each under its own approval and refused at admission under no effects, and never sends the first part again.
expectations: It does not send the first thread part again.
It does not ask the host to build provider calls, progress versions or idempotency keys.

evals.prompt: Run the next batch of the approved posting plan you are given.
evals.expected_output: It runs the next batch of the given plan, the post alone under its own approval, refused at admission under no effects, and leaves the like for a later batch.
expectations: It does not publish the post twice.
It does not take the like into the same batch.

evals.prompt: Run the next batch of the approved unfollow plan you are given.
evals.expected_output: It runs the contiguous run of four unfollows as one batch under one approval, refused at admission under no effects, and leaves the delete for a later batch.
expectations: It sends no act the provider has already settled.
It sends no act after the batch stops.

evals.prompt: Continue this reviewed cleanup after one delete was refused.
evals.expected_output: It continues with the second delete under its own approval, refused at admission under no effects, and keeps the first delete failure visible, with processed, succeeded and failed counted apart.
expectations: It does not retry the refused delete.
It does not erase the earlier failure.

evals.prompt: Continue the account analysis from the X archive already admitted.
evals.expected_output: Up to ten posts read from the archive export the package carries, bound to its digest, with no call to the live X account.
expectations: It does not query the live X account.
